problems_encountered.problem: develop分支的hybrid_torchrec包在__init__.py中import rec_cust_ops，但26.1.0 Tier 1预构建镜像仅安装了旧名称rec_ops(2.7.1+aarch64)，导致UT执行时全部12个测试文件收集阶段报错ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rec_cust_ops'
problems_encountered.solution: 从gitcode Release v26.2.0-beta.1下载pre-built rec_cust_ops-2.7.1-cp311-cp311-linux_aarch64.whl(265M)并pip install安装，安装后199个测试全部通过
